annotation.title_clean: 輸出貿易管理令別表第一及び外国為替令別表の規定に基づき貨物又は技術を定める省令
annotation.title_en: Ministerial Ordinance Specifying Goods or Technologies Pursuant to Appended Table 1 of the Export Trade Control Order and the Appended Table of the Foreign Exchange Order
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry (Japan)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese METI ministerial ordinance (1991, amended through Nov 2025, in force Feb 2026) specifying technical thresholds for goods and technologies subject to export and foreign-exchange controls. Covers nuclear materials, machine tools, lasers, cryptography and more; Article 1 item 20 controls certain robots and end-effectors (explosion-proof or radiation-hardened).
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines technical specifications for goods listed in Appended Table 1 of the Export Trade Control Order.
Controls nuclear materials, enrichment equipment, machine tools, lasers, and cryptographic equipment by parameters.
Item 20 controls robots and end-effectors that are explosion-proof or radiation-hardened (over 50,000 Gy), and their controllers.
Excludes teleoperated and sequence robots from the robot control item.
Amended by METI Ordinance No. 72 of Reiwa 7, effective 14 Feb 2026.
